text: Synthetic policy HR-001: Submit vacation requests in the employee portal at least 5 business days in advance. Manager approval is required.
Synthetic guide IT-001: For VPN connection issues, restart the approved VPN client and verify internet access. If it still fails, create an IT support ticket. Never share your password.
Synthetic policy ACCESS-001: Software access requires a manager-approved request and a license availability check.
Synthetic restricted document: Executive compensation review is restricted to the HR administration group.
